remotes.empty_description: Add a local bind-mount (the Compose volume) to use TestCopilot without a hosted git server.
remotes.sync_timeout: Sync is still running. Refresh this page in a moment.
remotes.name: Name
remotes.local_mount_hint: A local mount matches the Docker volume. Projects on this machine share the same workdir.

git_url.coming_soon: Public HTTPS repositories can be cloned and fetched. Private remotes and credential references are not supported yet.
git_url.sync_disabled: Sync clones or fetches the bound branch over HTTPS. Private remotes are not supported yet.
git_url.not_implemented: Private remotes are not supported yet. Use a public HTTPS URL.
git_url.credential_unavailable: Credential references are not supported yet. Use a public HTTPS URL.

modules.title: Module sources
modules.help: Each product module reads one data source. Folders are discovered by convention, not configured here.

conventions.testhub: Expects a test-platform repo: apps.index_platform, allowlisted CLIs, and assets/sql.
conventions.features: Reads ./*/feature/, packages/action_words, packages/api_objects, packages/page_objects, and assets/ddl when present. Can share TestCopilot's data source.
conventions.environments: Reads config/env.py and env/*.yaml templates. Never reads env_local or secret values.
conventions.wiki: Reads docs/ or wiki/ markdown from the bound workdir.
conventions.prd: Reads prd/ markdown from the bound workdir.
